jokes.label: Joke A
jokes.title: Supporting Evidence
jokes.joke: In college, I got drunk and emailed my professor, “I deserve a better grade.” The next morning he replied, “Your argument lacks evidence.” So I sent him security footage of me trying to unlock my dorm with a slice of pizza. He raised the grade—not for the essay, but because I’d finally supported a claim.

jokes.label: Joke B
jokes.title: Last Known Rental
jokes.joke: I did something stupid while drunk in college. I joined Blockbuster's DVD rewards program. Lifetime membership, they said. Fifty free rentals, they said. I've been holding onto that card for fifteen years like it's a savings bond. My friends invested in crypto, I invested in a company that now exists only as a single store in Bend, Oregon, staffed by a man who is basically a folk hero. I'm not mad. I'm diversified in nostalgia. It's due back never.

jokes.label: Joke C
jokes.title: Polite Intoxication
jokes.joke: I am dangerously courteous when I'm drunk. Normal people get hammered and text their ex. I get blacked out and leave glowing Yelp reviews for ATMs. Last night I got so trashed I passed out on my neighbor’s front lawn. But I did it respectfully. I woke up curled in the fetal position, holding a handwritten sign that said, 'Please keep off the grass.'

jokes.label: Joke D
jokes.title: Sandy Regrets
jokes.joke: I went to a beach party last summer and ended up doing something stupid while drunk. My buddies buried me in the sand up to my neck for laughs, and I passed out cold. Woke up to the tide rolling in and seagulls circling overhead. Turns out those birds don't care if you're a human statue—they treated me like an open buffet. I haven't been invited back since.

jokes.label: Joke E
jokes.title: Beachside Genius
jokes.joke: I got way too drunk at a beach party and decided I should give a TED Talk in the sand. I stood on a cooler like it was a stage and announced, “Tonight, I solve all of humanity’s problems!” Then I immediately fell off, knocked over the chips, and declared, “Step one: gravity is rude.”
